meta.name: help
meta.description: Show documentation for pk and its commands

inlines.text: Renders plankit's documentation in a terminal. The same pages ship as skills in the plugin, compiled from one source.

blocks.text:
pk help
pk help <topic>
pk help document
pk help document > plankit.md
pk help document --format man > pk.1
man ./pk.1

inlines.text: Without a topic, prints the index. At a terminal you get styled, wrapped text; redirect or pipe it and you get the page's markdown.
keeps the styled page through a pipe, for a pager like
prints every page in one go, in the order the index lists them: for reading straight through, or for keeping as a file.
writes a man page instead, for one topic or for the whole set. Read it back with
matters, or man searches its manpath for a page of that name and finds none.

blocks.text:
--project-dir <value>
        Project directory (default: PK_PROJECT_DIR, else the current directory)
  --plain
        Undecorated output: no color, no wrapping
  --quiet
        Suppress notes and hints (errors still print)

--format <value>
        Output format: text or man (default text)
